title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 42
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 42: the remnant asking Jeremiah to pray, the answer that came after ten days, and the warning against going to Egypt.

questions.text: What did the captains and all the people ask Jeremiah the prophet to do?
questions.explanation: They asked Jeremiah to let their supplication be presented and to pray for them to Yahweh his God, that he might show them the way in which they should walk and the things they should do.

answers.text: To pray to Yahweh his God and show them the way they should walk
To go before them into the land of Egypt
To choose a governor over the remnant of Judah
To write their words in a scroll of a book

questions.text: What did Jeremiah promise them when he agreed to pray?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said he would pray to Yahweh their God according to their words, and that whatever Yahweh answered he would declare to them, keeping nothing back.

answers.text: That Yahweh would answer within three days
That he would go with them wherever they went
That he would declare Yahweh's answer and keep nothing back
That he would say only what was good for them to hear

questions.text: What did the people swear before Jeremiah about Yahweh's answer?
questions.explanation: They said that whether it was good or bad, they would obey the voice of Yahweh their God, to whom they were sending him.

answers.text: That they would obey only if it was good for them
That whether it was good or bad, they would obey it
That they would first bring their offerings
That they would tell no man what he said

questions.text: How long was it before Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: After ten days, Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah.

answers.text: After three days
After seven days
After forty days
After ten days

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise if they would still live in this land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that if they would still live in this land, he would build them and not pull them down, and plant them and not pluck them up, for he grieved over the distress he had brought on them.

answers.text: That he would build them and plant them, not pull them down
That he would make them rulers over the nations
That they would never see war again
That he would give them back the king's daughters

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell them not to be afraid of, and why?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told them not to be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom they were afraid, for he was with them to save them and to deliver them from his hand.

answers.text: Not to fear the sword, for it would pass them by
Not to fear the famine, for the land would yield
Not to fear the king of Babylon, for he was with them to save them
Not to fear the Chaldeans, for they had gone to Egypt

questions.text: What did the people say they would find in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: They said they would go into the land of Egypt, where they would see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread.

answers.text: Grain and cattle in great number for the remnant
No war, no sound of the trumpet and no hunger of bread
A king who would defend the remnant of Judah
A place to serve Yahweh in peace

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would overtake those who set their faces to enter Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that the sword they feared would overtake them there in the land of Egypt, and the famine they were afraid of would follow close behind them there, and they would die there.

answers.text: The armies of the nations round about
A pestilence sent on their cattle
A drought of three years in the land
The sword and the famine they feared

questions.text: What did Yahweh say they would become if they entered Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said his wrath would be poured out on them when they entered Egypt, and they would be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse and a reproach, and would see this place no more.

answers.text: An object of horror, an astonishment, a curse and a reproach
A people without a name among the nations
Servants in the house of Pharaoh forever
A remnant scattered among all the kingdoms

questions.text: What did Jeremiah say about their obedience, and what would happen in the place where they wanted to live?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said they had not obeyed Yahweh their God's voice in anything, and that they would die by the sword, by the famine and by the pestilence in the place where they desired to go to live.

answers.text: They had obeyed in part, and would be spared in part
They had not obeyed, and would die there by sword, famine and pestilence
They had obeyed, and would be brought back to their own land
They had not asked, and so would not be answered
